title: HHKB Professional BT (US) as a JIS keyboard, for JIS Korean

rules.description: HHKB Pro BT (US) as JIS: right ⌥ is a second Fn, with the HHKB US Fn layer [Fn: standard]
HHKB Pro BT (US) as JIS: right ⌥ is a second Fn, with ⌘⇧4 on I and Play/Pause on P [Fn: Mac extras]
HHKB Pro BT (US) as JIS: カタカナ, 英数, かな and ろ on tap, ¥ on \ [required]

manipulators.description: Left ⌥: tap カタカナ (to Korean), hold ⌥
Left ⌘: tap 英数 (to English), hold ⌘
Right ⌘: tap かな (to Japanese), hold ⌘
Right Shift: tap ろ, hold Shift

rules.description: HHKB Pro BT (US) as JIS: JIS ] (む) on Delete, Backspace on ` (as on an HHKB JIS) [recommended]
HHKB Pro BT (US) as JIS: JIS ] (む) on `, Delete stays [alternative: keeps HHKB US Backspace habits]
